title: The Cycle
review: This is an interesting mashup of a {Longlegs} style dark detective drama, with another type of horror subgenre entirely. I think it'll appeal more to horror fans who are more aware of the tropes, and want to see this unique take, with old-fashioned effects. They will be more forgiving of its flaws. Casual horror viewers picking something out for Halloween, might take more issue with it. The second half is definitely more cheesy. The ending in particular lost me; I was ultimately a little disappointed. Also, why do they have to wait for a 3D printer just to see what shape a computer generated skull would be. It would be faster to render digitally, than physically.
